description: This file contains utility functions for filtering, sorting, and paginating recipe data, including functions for matching recipes based on query, category, ingredients, and sorting criteria.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] paginate(items: List[Any], page: int, limit: int)
methods.description: Paginate a list of items: calculates start/end indices, slices the list, and returns pagination info.

methods.name: str _norm(s: str)
methods.description: Normalize a string by stripping whitespace and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: bool recipe_matches_query(recipe: Dict, q: str)
methods.description: Check if a recipe's title or description matches a search query.

methods.name: bool recipe_matches_category(recipe: Dict, category: str)
methods.description: Check if a recipe's category matches a specified category (case-insensitive).

methods.name: bool recipe_matches_ingredients_or(recipe: Dict, ingredients_csv: str)
methods.description: Determine if any ingredients in a recipe match any tokens from a comma-separated string, using OR logic.

methods.name: bool recipe_matches_include_all(recipe: Dict, include_csv: str)
methods.description: Determine if a recipe includes all tokens from a comma-separated string within its ingredients, using AND logic.

methods.name: List[Dict] sort_recipes(recipes: List[Dict], sort_by: str)
methods.description: Sort a list of recipes based on 'rating' or 'title'.

ctags.name: paginate
ctags.pattern: /^def paginate(items: List[Any], page: int, limit: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/
